hero.caption: This is a photo of Bijia Mountain at high tide, near en:Jinzhou City in en:Liaoning, en:China. At low tide, a land-bridge appears between the mainland and the mountain, allowing visitors to walk from one shore to the other. (This Jinzhou is near the northern tip of Liaoning Bay; not to be confused with Jinzhou District of Dalian city, on Jinzhou Bay, about 200km to the south.
